headline: LSU looks to shake off Texas blowout against Arkansas
subhead: Two ranked teams enter Fayetteville with contrasting momentum after conference losses.

xFactor.why: Arkansas held Georgia to 24 points last week and will need that same pressure to rattle an LSU offense searching for answers after allowing 40 to Texas.

keyMatchup: LSU's offensive line must restore credibility against an Arkansas front seven that has shown real bite in recent weeks.
body: LSU arrives in Fayetteville still reeling from a 40-8 dismantling at Texas that exposed serious vulnerabilities on both sides of the ball. The Tigers have been outscored 48 points in two straight games and need a reset badly, but Arkansas is not the ideal opponent for a confidence-building bounce-back. The Razorbacks allowed just 24 to Georgia in a tight loss and have quietly built one of the more disruptive defenses in the league.

Arkansas sits ranked higher despite identical conference quality wins, suggesting the selection committee sees something clicking here. The Razorbacks' path runs through controlling the line of scrimmage on both sides, a formula that has worked in recent weeks. If LSU's offensive line remains fractured and the passing game cannot find rhythm early, Arkansas will lean on that defensive advantage and controlled running game to steal a critical conference win in front of home crowd.
